name: draftmeld
description: Open-source fantasy football draft command center.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.audit: npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix apps/web audit --audit-level=high
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run check && npm --prefix apps/web run check && node scripts/go-format.mjs --check && node scripts/check-source-size.mjs && cd backend && go vet ./... && go vet ../scripts/zip-directory.go
scripts.format: npm --prefix frontend run format && npm --prefix apps/web run format && node scripts/go-format.mjs
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix apps/web run format:check && node scripts/go-format.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:web && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: node scripts/check-go-coverage.mjs && cd backend && go test ../scripts/zip-directory.go ../scripts/zip-directory_test.go
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run audit && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
